# HSBTE LEET — Complete Site Documentation for LLMs

> HSBTE LEET (hsbteleet.com) is India's most comprehensive educational platform dedicated to Haryana LEET (Lateral Entry Entrance Test) preparation and HSBTE Diploma Polytechnic previous year question papers. Built by a Government Polytechnic student (Nishant), the platform serves 50,000+ diploma students across Haryana with free PYQ downloads, exam resources, AI-powered preparation tools, premium counselling services, and complete chapter-wise notes.

## What is Haryana LEET?

Haryana LEET (Lateral Entry Entrance Test) is a state-level entrance examination conducted by HSTES (Haryana State Technical Education Society) for admission to the 2nd year of B.Tech / B.E. and B.Pharmacy programs through lateral entry. It is open to diploma holders from HSBTE-affiliated polytechnics in Haryana.

### Exam Details
- **Full Name**: Lateral Entry Entrance Test (LEET) / OCET (Online Common Entrance Test)
- **Conducting Body**: HSTES (Haryana State Technical Education Society)
- **Official Website**: https://hstes.org.in
- **Counselling Portal**: https://techadmissionshry.gov.in
- **Exam Type**: Computer-Based Test (CBT)
- **Total Questions**: 90 MCQs
- **Total Marks**: 90
- **Duration**: 90 minutes
- **Negative Marking**: NONE — attempt all 90 questions
- **Eligibility**: Diploma holders (3-year), min 45% marks (40% for SC/ST from Haryana)

### Exam Pattern (Section-wise)
- **Section A – Basic Sciences (Q1-25, 25 marks)**:
  - a-1: Mathematics (8 marks)
  - a-2: Physics (8 marks)
  - a-3: Chemistry (3 marks)
  - a-4: Communication Skills (3 marks)
  - a-5: General Awareness (3 marks)
- **Section B – Electronics Stream (Q26-50, 25 marks)**: b-1 Electrical, b-2 Electronics, b-3 Computer
- **Section C – Mechanical Stream (Q51-70, 20 marks)**: c-1 Mechanical, c-2 Production, c-3 Automobile
- **Section D – Other Streams (Q71-90, 20 marks)**: d-1 Civil, d-2 Textile, d-3 Chemical/Printing, d-4 Ceramic, d-5 Food, d-6 Others

**Important**: Students attempt Section A (25Q) + ONE stream section (B, C, or D) = 90 questions total.

### Key Colleges for LEET Admission
- DCRUST Murthal (Deenbandhu Chhotu Ram University of Science & Technology) — Sonipat
- YMCA Faridabad (YMCA University of Science & Technology)
- NIT Kurukshetra (National Institute of Technology)
- KUK Kurukshetra (Kurukshetra University)
- MDU Rohtak (Maharshi Dayanand University)
- GJU Hisar (Guru Jambheshwar University of Science & Technology)
- IGU Rewari (Indira Gandhi University)
- Gurugram University
- Various private engineering colleges in Haryana

## Security Features (Premium Pages)

All 46 full-length premium sample paper pages have ultra-high security:
- **Copy/cut/paste/select-all blocked** (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+A, etc.)
- **PrintScreen blocked** (auto-detected, logged)
- **Developer tools blocked** (F12, Ctrl+Shift+I — page hides content)
- **Print blocked** (Ctrl+P, browser print)
- **Context menu (right-click) disabled**
- **Drag-to-copy disabled**
- **Watermark on every page** — user's mobile number embedded in all content
- **Violation auto-logging to Supabase** — every violation recorded with user ID, violation type, paper name, device info, timestamp
- **Admin notification system** — violations visible in premium admin portal with "Send Warning Email" and "Permanent Ban" buttons
- **Terms & Conditions** at https://hsbteleet.com/terms

## Notes System — Complete Chapter-wise Notes

**URL**: https://hsbteleet.com/leet-notes

Complete notes covering the full HSTES syllabus:

### Section A — Basic Sciences
- **Mathematics (23 topics)**: Arithmetic Progressions, Complex Numbers, Logarithms, Permutations & Combinations, Binomial Theorem, Probability, Trigonometry, Straight Lines, Differentiation, Indefinite Integration, Differential Equations, Statistics, Matrices, Circles, GP/HP/Successive Differences, Maxima-Minima, Definite Integration, Applications of Integration, Mean, Median, Mode, Mean Deviation, Standard Deviation
- **Physics (10 topics)**: Units & Dimensions, 1D Motion & Newton's Laws, Work-Energy-Power, Properties of Matter (Elasticity/Surface Tension/Viscosity), Waves & SHM, Rotational Motion, Heat & Temperature, Geometrical Optics, Electrostatics, Laser & Superconductivity & Energy Sources
- **Chemistry (6 topics)**: Hard/Soft Water & Hardness Treatment, Acidity/Basicity/pH, Ion Exchange Method, Electronic Configuration (Z=1-30), Equivalent Weight & Valency, Chemical Symbols/Formulae/Equations
- **Communication Skills (6 topics)**: Vocabulary (synonyms/antonyms/one-word substitutions), Prepositions, Active/Passive Voice & Direct/Indirect Speech, Reading Comprehension & Narration, Tenses (all 12 tenses), Punctuation
- **General Awareness (5 topics)**: Haryana Technology & Institutions, LEET Exam Rules & Pattern, Counselling Process, Haryana Geography, Haryana History

### Section B — Electronics Stream
- **Electrical (7 topics)**: Basic Circuits/KCL/KVL/Ohm's Law, Network Theorems (Thevenin/Norton/Superposition), AC Circuits & Power Factor, Transformers, DC Machines & Generators, AC Motors & Synchronous Motors, Power Transmission & Protection
- **Electronics (9 topics)**: Diodes & Rectifiers & Zener, BJT & FET/MOSFET, Operational Amplifiers, Digital Logic & Boolean Algebra, Flip-Flops & Counters & Registers, Modulation (AM/FM/Digital), Electrical Measurements & CRO, Transducers (Thermocouple/RTD/LVDT/Piezo), Industrial Electronics (SCR/DIAC/TRIAC/UJT/IGBT)
- **Computer (6 topics)**: Computer Fundamentals & Generations, Computer Architecture & CPU & Memory, Operating Systems & Process Management, C Programming, Pointers & Data Structures, Computer Networking & OSI Model

### Section C — Mechanical Stream
- **Mechanical (7 topics)**: Applied Mechanics (Force/Friction/Equilibrium), Strength of Materials (Stress/Strain/Young's Modulus), SFD & BMD, Thermodynamics & Laws, Heat Transfer (Conduction/Convection/Radiation), Fluid Mechanics (Bernoulli/Pascal/Reynolds), Bernoulli's Theorem Applications
- **Production (8 topics)**: Lathe Machine, Milling Machine, Metrology & Measuring Instruments, Welding (SMAW/MIG/TIG), Material Science & Heat Treatment, Engineering Drawing & Projection, Foundry & Casting, Industrial Management (PPC/TQM/EOQ)
- **Automobile (6 topics)**: IC Engine & Power Train, Clutch & Gearbox, Differential & Drive Types, Cooling & Lubrication Systems, Brakes/Tyres/Steering, Electric & Hybrid Vehicles

### Section D — Other Engineering Streams
- **Civil (14 topics)**: Repair & Maintenance, Bricks & Brickwork, Soil Mechanics, Water Supply & Treatment, Foundations, Surveying, RCC Design, Roofs/Doors/Windows, Roads & Pavements, Bridges, Irrigation & Dams, Dams & Reservoirs, Cement Chemistry, Environmental Engineering
- **Textile (3 topics)**: Fibres (Natural/Synthetic), Weaving & Looms, Dyeing/Printing/Finishing
- **Chemical/Printing (2 topics)**: Chemical Process Industry & Agro Industries, Petrochemicals & Printing Processes
- **Ceramic (2 topics)**: Ceramic Classification, Ceramic Materials & Glass
- **Food Technology (2 topics)**: Vitamins & Nutrition, Milk & Dairy Technology
- **Others (3 topics)**: Agricultural Engineering & Farm Equipment, History of Indian Architecture, Fashion Design & Garment Manufacturing

## Admin Portal

**URL**: https://hsbteleet.com/premium-admin (password protected)

Features:
- Dashboard: total users, revenue, recent signups
- All Users: search, filter, block/unblock, upgrade to Ultra, delete
- Payments: transaction history, revenue breakdown
- Student Reviews: approve/reject reviews
- **Security Violations**: view all violation logs (type, user, paper, device, time), Send Warning Email button, Permanent Ban button
- **User Activity**: per-user paper attempts, practice time, last login, devices used, violation count
- **Push Notifications**: push announcements to all users or specific mobile number (info/warning/success/urgent types); shown on premium-papers page
- Send Message: WhatsApp message generator
- Add User Manually: for cash/UPI payments outside Razorpay
- User Lookup: search by mobile

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend**: Static HTML/CSS/JS — pure vanilla, no framework
- **CSS**: Custom CSS with CSS variables (dark mode on notes page, premium pages)
- **Fonts**: Google Fonts (DM Sans, Syne, Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono)
- **Icons**: Font Awesome 6.2.1
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Pages with Cloudflare Functions
- **Serverless**: Cloudflare Pages Functions (`/functions/api/chat.js`)
- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
  - Tables: premium_users, premium_payments, premium_access, ultra_premium_users, security_violations, admin_announcements, counseling_users, counseling_requests, reviews, req_approval, referrals
  - RLS enabled on all tables
- **Payment**: Razorpay (one-time, no recurring)
- **AI API**: Google Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash primary, 2.0-flash, 1.5-flash fallback)
- **Analytics**: Google Analytics 4 (G-WR1BG2HCE0) + Microsoft Clarity
- **Ads**: Google AdSense (ca-pub-3142279668395491) — free pages only
- **Notifications**: Supabase admin_announcements table → displayed on premium-papers page
- **Security**: premium-security.js — copy/screenshot/devtools protection on all 54 premium papers + watermarking
- **HTML Partials**: header, footer, chatbot, bottom-nav loaded via `data-include` attribute

## AI Features

### Site Chatbot (All Pages)
- Floating chat widget (bottom-right)
- Powered by Gemini AI (via shared/chat-knowledge.js)
- Responds in Hinglish (Hindi + English)
- Knowledge: PYQ links, syllabus, LEET info, premium pricing (₹69/₹99)
- Abuse detection + Hinglish roast response
- Rate limited: 8 requests per minute

### Ultra Premium AI Tools
- AI College Predictor (rank+category → college recommendations based on 2027 data)
- Rank Predictor (expected marks → predicted rank range, calibrated to 2027 data: 39 marks ≈ Rank 112)
- AI Smart Counselling Advisor (dream college → Round 1/2/3 strategy)
- AI Choice Filling Generator (rank+category+branch → optimized choice list)
- Cutoff Analyzer (closing ranks for YMCA, DCRUST, GJU, KUK, MDU, CDLU by category)
- Choice Mistake Detector (paste choices → checks ordering errors)
- College Comparison Tool (two colleges → side-by-side + AI verdict)
- Upgrade Chance Calculator (probability of upgrading in Round 2/3)
- Mock Counselling Simulator
- AI Study Planner (weak/strong topics → phase-wise study plan)

## Supabase Database Schema (Key Tables)

- **premium_users**: id, full_name, mobile, email, password_hash, created_at
- **premium_payments**: id, user_id, amount, status, razorpay_payment_id, created_at
- **premium_access**: id, user_id, is_active, tier, last_login, papers_attempted, total_time_mins, devices_count, expires_at
- **ultra_premium_users**: id, user_id, mobile, full_name, email, created_at
- **security_violations**: id, user_id, violation_type, page_context, device_info, ip_address, created_at
- **admin_announcements**: id, title, message, type (info/warning/success/urgent), target_mobile, is_active, created_at, expires_at
- **counseling_users**: id, full_name, mobile, email, password_hash, category, dob, created_at
- **counseling_requests**: id, user_id, rank, branch preferences, status (pending/reviewed/sent)
- **counseling_responses**: id, request_id, suggested_college, admin_suggestions
- **reviews / req_approval**: student reviews system with admin moderation

- Best for: Book = full preparation from scratch; Short Notes = last 2-3 weeks revision. Both are independent study aids by Nishant, not official HSTES material.
